vvb_guidance.title: VVB Guidance September 1 - September 30
vvb_guidance.section_title: AECN Rail — Basis for Loaded Mass (Week 3, INJ-09-2026-W3)
vvb_guidance.quote_scope: The basis described here applies to Week 3 of this Reporting Period, INJ-09-2026-W3, covering 11 – 18 September 2026, and to that week alone. For all other weeks in this Reporting Period, the mass loaded at origin is taken from the metric-tons figure stated on the Bill of Lading.
vvb_guidance.quote_method: For railcar shipments of AECN third-party bio-oil in that week, the mass loaded at origin is derived from the volume recorded on the Bill of Lading and a bio-oil density of 1.22 kg/L: Loaded mass (kg) = BOL volume at 60°F (L) × 1.22 kg/L
vvb_guidance.quote_volume_source: The volume at 60°F is taken from the Product Shipment Summary on each Bill of Lading; a railcar is loaded by three shipments and its loaded mass is the sum of the three.
vvb_guidance.quote_offloaded: Mass offloaded at the injection site is measured independently, by certified truck scale, as the difference between full and empty weights for each offload. Sparging and filtration losses are deducted from the offloaded mass to give the Mass of Bio-Oil Injected, which is subtracted directly from the railcar’s loaded mass.
vvb_guidance.quote_multi_week: Where a railcar is offloaded across more than one reporting week, the loaded mass is recorded once, in the week the railcar’s first offload occurs, and subsequent weeks draw against the same shipment.
vvb_guidance.no_other_sections: Doc contains no trailer-standard-empty-weight or other substitution section; if a cell comment cites another method, the July/August docs are to be read for it.

policy.fc11_text: On the last offload of the railcar, MRV applies a back-calc: if the sum of all offloads' raw scale tickets exceeds the BOL inbound aggregate, the last offload's Cargo (kg) = BOL_total − sum(prior offloads' raw scale tickets).
policy.last_reported_rule: FC11 reconciliation lands on the RP's *last-reported* batch from a given railcar — not necessarily the railcar's *physical-last* batch.
policy.bcu_fix_rule: fix = enter the exact process figure, never round down either
